summary: Iter341/342 — Full carpool test pass. Backend: created new test_iter342_carpool_requests.py covering reverse-matching CRUD (requests create/list/my/cancel), fulfill flow (ride with request_id flips request->'fulfilled' + sends 'carpool_request_fulfilled' notification), and admin/revenue auth gating (401 anon / 403 user / 200 admin). 4/4 PASS. Re-verified pre-existing test_iter341_carpool_revenue.py (3/3) and test_iter338_carpool.py (5/5) — all pass individually (running them together still triggers the documented per-file asyncio loop conflict). HTTP smoke via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL also PASS for /api/carpool/admin/revenue, /api/carpool/requests CRUD with real auth tokens. Frontend: /admin/carpool-revenue renders fully (admin-carpool-revenue container + 7 KPI cards kpi-{commission,gross,payout,rides,seats,drivers,avg} + 4 presets all/7d/30d/90d + chart + top-drivers) and preset switching reloads without error. /carpool composer publishes a new ride (toast + ride appears in 'Mes trajets'), Demandes tab opens RequestComposer, creates a request that appears in the list with fulfill-request button visible. Mes trajets tab loads correctly. Only nit: 'publish-preview' is conditional on from/to state being set via GooglePlacesInput onChange — in headless without Places autocomplete, the wrapper.fill() doesn't propagate state, so the preview block is not rendered (expected per spec note); the ride itself still publishes.
verified_scenarios: GET /api/carpool/admin/revenue admin-token -> 200 with full schema {currency, commission_percent, kpis{...7 keys}, top_drivers[], daily[]} (HTTP smoke + pytest).
GET /api/carpool/admin/revenue?date_from=&date_to= filters work (200, rides=0 when out-of-range, pytest also asserts driver excluded for ancient range).
POST /api/carpool/requests (auth) creates demand with id cpreq_*, status=open (HTTP + pytest).
GET /api/carpool/requests lists open ones (HTTP + pytest), supports pickup/dropoff regex filters.
POST /api/carpool/requests/{id}/cancel by non-owner -> 404; by owner -> {ok:true}; cancelled doc disappears from open list (pytest + HTTP).

POST /api/carpool/rides {request_id:<open>} -> request becomes status='fulfilled' with ride_id+fulfilled_at AND notifications collection gets a 'carpool_request_fulfilled' entry for the passenger with data{ride_id,request_id} (pytest).

Frontend /admin/carpool-revenue: 'admin-carpool-revenue' + all 7 KPI testids + 4 preset chips + carpool-revenue-chart + carpool-revenue-top-drivers all rendered; clicking carpool-revenue-preset-7d reloads and doesn't crash. Empty-state messaging ('Pas encore de trajet terminé sur cette période.', 'Aucun chauffeur sur cette période.') displays correctly when no completed rides.

Frontend /carpool: tab-search/tab-requests/tab-mine all present; publish-trip-btn opens publish-modal with header 'Publiez en quelques taps' and all expected testids (publish-from/to/my-location/seats/price/+/-/net/notes/submit + 3 slot chips + 4 seat buttons). Filling text + slot + price+, clicking publish-submit produces success toast and new ride visible in tab-mine.
Frontend Demandes tab: post-request-btn opens request-modal with all expected testids; submit creates demand visible as request-cpreq_* card with fulfill-request-cpreq_* button.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/carpool.py — requests endpoints clean: id prefixed 'cpreq_', _id projection excluded, max_price normalised, notes capped at 200 chars, seats clamped 1..8.

create_carpool_ride correctly handles request_id: looks up status='open' first, then sets status='fulfilled' + ride_id + fulfilled_at, and dispatches notification with structured data{ride_id,request_id}. Good idempotency: only fulfills if currently open (no double-fulfill).
cancel_carpool_request uses 404 for both 'not found' and 'not owner' — good (avoids leaking existence).

carpool_admin_revenue: clean aggregation in Python on completed rides; gracefully handles missing completed_at by falling back to departure_date for date filtering; commission_percent + currency surfaced from config; top_drivers limited to 10, daily limited to last 30 — good defaults.

Composer publish-preview only renders when (from && to) are non-empty strings. With GooglePlacesInput the state is set via its onChange callback; tests using raw input.fill() on the wrapper won't update React state, hence preview missing in headless. Not a bug — publish still works.

Pre-existing harness limitation: running multiple carpool pytest files in one invocation fails with 'attached to a different loop' (motor binds client to first loop). Each file uses its own _LOOP via asyncio.set_event_loop. Running individually -> all pass. Consider migrating to pytest-asyncio with anyio loop scope or a single shared loop fixture in conftest for cleaner CI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin revenue dashboard + publish composer + requests composer)
